title: Critique: integrated information as a criterion leads to quasi-panpsychism

statements.text: IIT's surprising entailments are quasi-panpsychism, subjectivity without referents or dynamics, and the possibility of fully intelligent yet unconscious brain simulations. Any theory that equates maxima of integrated information with experience inherits them.

sources.quote: IIT has produced controversy because of its surprising entailments: quasi-panpsychism; subjectivity without referents or dynamics; and the possibility of fully-intelligent-yet-unconscious brain simulations
